comment: Source of truth for the action vocabulary shared by the TypeScript decision service and the Python executors. Every kind here must have an entry in ACTION_EXECUTORS (tests/test_action_contract.py) so an ID the service can offer is always one Python can run.

walk.summary: Navigate to a tile on a named map, used for doorways and map edges.

talk.summary: Approach a loaded map object and interact with it.

interact.summary: Face and examine a background event tile: a sign, an object, or a hidden item.

starter.summary: Take one of the three Pokemon from Birch's bag.

battle-move.summary: Use one of the active battler's moves.

battle-switch.summary: Send out a different, unfainted party member.

battle-item.summary: Use a healing, PP or stat item from the bag during a battle.

catch.summary: Throw a Poke Ball at a wild opponent.

battle-run.summary: Attempt to escape a wild encounter.

heal.summary: Walk to a reachable Pokemon Center, restore the party, and return outside.

setup.summary: Configured character creation, before the player has any control. Python only.

dialogue.summary: Advance mandatory cutscene text. Deterministic, never a model decision.
